subject: NexWave: remediation stipend proposal for Aug 26 outage
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nexwave.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: support@nexwave.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 21:03:00 -0700
Subject: Service outage on Aug 26 impacting call-transcription (severity 2)

Rachel,

We had a ~47 minute window (13:12–13:59 PDT) where Redwood returns spiked latency and elevated 5xxs for our call-transcription route. That caused a backlog in our ingestion pipeline and a degraded UX for customers. Our SREs collected logs and I'll attach a short incident summary.

We understand transient issues happen, but given contract language around high-availability for that route and the size of our bill this month, we need to understand the remediation path and whether Redwood will offer a financial accommodation (credit or service month) for the disruption. Please advise next steps and timeline — our renewal discussion is also coming up and we want to include this in the conversation.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Operations
NexWave Communications

Attachments: nexwave_downtime_summary_2026-08-26.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nexwave.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service outage on Aug 26 impacting call-transcription (severity 2)

Hi Elena — thanks for the write-up and the attachment. I’m really sorry for the disruption; we know this route is critical for NexWave’s realtime product. I’ve opened an internal incident review and asked engineering to prioritize the logs you provided.

Quick ask: can you confirm the approximate token volume and the percent of traffic that hit the degraded path during the window? That helps us size any remediation. For transparency: typical remediation offers are scoped by impact and contract SLOs — I’ll follow up with an internal approver request today and aim to give you a proposal within 72 hours.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive (Strategic Accounts)
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: FW: NexWave outage — quantifying impact and draft remediation

Rachel / Lauren — forwarding NexWave's note. Engineering has confirmed the elevated latency coincides with a kernel-level scheduling regression in one of our autoscale hosts; root cause patch applied by 14:10 PDT. Attached are the token-level logs pulled from the serving cluster (svc_latency_logs_2026-08-26.csv).

Quick suggested remediation options to propose to NexWave:
- Option A: One month free service credit (applied as 100% invoice credit for Sept) — customer-visible, simple.
- Option B: $12,500 one-time credit (approx. equal to ~40% of Aug bill) plus a waived overage charge (if any) — targeted compensation.
- Option C: No monetary credit but a technical remediation plan + engineering time commitment (2 SRE days) and a 1-month post-incident monitoring package.

I recommend Option B for balance between fairness and precedent. If leadership prefers to be more generous (Option A) we should be explicit about duration and that it’s a one-time gesture.

—Marcus
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NexWave outage — quantifying impact and draft remediation

Marcus — thanks for the options and the logs. A couple of notes from finance and renewals:
- NexWave is a mid-enterprise account with strong expansion potential; they’re in month 11 of their annual commit.
- Historical gross margin on this account is ~32%.
- Legal needs a short amendment for any credit beyond standard invoice adjustments.

Vivek — can you sign off on a one-time credit of $12.5k (Option B) plus a technical post-incident consult (2 SRE days), with the amendment drafted by Legal? This keeps precedent tighter than a free-month blanket credit but acknowledges operational impact. If you prefer a goodwill free month, I need explicit exec approval.

—Lauren
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NexWave outage — quantifying impact and draft remediation

All — I approve Option B: authorize a one-time $12,500 remediation credit and include a 2 SRE day consult (no charge). Ask Legal to prepare a short amendment and Billing to apply the credit to NexWave’s September invoice. Please inform the customer and outline next steps.

Rachel — you have delegation to finalize with the customer and route the amendment to Legal. Keep the communication concise: scope the credit, confirm timeline for contract amendment, and offer the post-incident consult scheduling.

—Vivek
On Mon, 30 Aug 2026 at 17:36, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nexwave.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 17:36:00 -0700
Subject: NexWave remediation proposal (per exec approval)

Elena — thanks again for the incident details and for your patience while we reviewed internally. Per our executive decision, Redwood will issue a one-time account credit of $12,500 applied to your September invoice and provide a 2 SRE-day post-incident consult (no charge) to validate mitigations and advise on autoscale parameters.

Next steps:
- Legal will prepare a short amendment documenting the credit and consult; I'll route that within 48 hours.
- Billing will schedule the credit to appear on Sept invoice; tell me if you need it as an immediate refund instead.
- Please let me know 2–3 preferred windows for the consult and we’ll pair your SRE team with ours.

Attached: svc_latency_logs_2026-08-26.csv (supporting materials).

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive (Strategic Accounts)
Redwood Inference
